title: Community manual review and immutable inline preview
objective: Deliver ADR-0016 authorized manual moderation and alpha.3 preview with contract-first alpha.4, real identity/state/concurrency checks, runtime image and evidence-backed SDK operations.
in_scope: Lock alpha.4 reviewer scope, closed request, idempotent decision endpoint and bounded errors before producer changes
Manual/disabled modes, explicit immutable candidate approve/reject, reviewer audit, atomic publication/outbox and owner/reviewer concurrency fencing
Implement alpha.3 inline PNG preview with download-identical visibility and safe headers
Generate public types; advance Community SDK only after real producer evidence; preserve Core/Skin contracts
Full declared static/contract/integration/runtime/SDK gates, docs and closed local-main records
out_of_scope: F4 queue/admin/social/Web endpoints; external machine moderation; full Q-010 role policy
Skin takeover, Core/Ops writes, production deployment or remote push
Formal license/retention decisions and production object-store/backup proof
contract_impact: Compatible prerelease addition alpha.4 to alpha.3: moderation:review scope and reviewResourceVersion endpoint under accepted ADR-0016. Existing scopes and public resource schemas unchanged. Producer then SDK order.
acceptance_evidence: Actual PostgreSQL/S3 and real Keycloak active reviewer authorization; no review leaves pending
Approve/reject, replay/conflict, reviewer attribution, multiple reviewers, stale candidates, replacement and unpublish races; fault rollback
Preview exact sealed bytes and no-store/inline/nosniff/sandbox; unpublished addressing 404
Full declared gates, final source runtime image and real SDK smoke, coordination Finish and clean main integration
validation_results: Owner explicitly selected temporary manual review in this chat; accepted ADR-0016 already records exact authority/endpoint semantics. All six worktrees clean, no active business locks. Scope includes preview producer prerequisite already locked in alpha.3.
